t: The Hager Sollysta WMPB1/46 1-gang surface pattress back box is designed for reliable surface-mounted electrical installations. With a generous 46mm internal depth, this single back box offers ample space for wiring, ensuring a neat and safe finish. Features fixed lugs for secure attachment and 20mm knockouts located on the top, bottom, side, and rear for versatile cable entry options. Its clean white finish perfectly complements other Hager Sollysta moulded wiring accessories.
